argument_hint: Figma component/set URL; optionally preceded by a C-### id or component name when amending a known row

name: ui2-component-build
description: Build ONE specced UI 2.0 component as a capturable SwiftUI preview — resolve its dependencies, regenerate the tokens, write the view under iphone/MakeReadyUI/, generate its fixture + ViewRegistry case, capture it in the simulator, and diff the render against its frozen Figma snapshot. The build-side sibling of /ui2-component; these views ship — never hand-wired; the app wires them from `iphone/MakeReady/UI2/` containers (ui2-shell D2/D29). Designed to run in a FRESH session.
argument_hint: C-### registry id (or component name); omit to be shown the specced-but-unbuilt rows

name: ui2-component-delete
description: Retire a UI 2.0 registry row that should never have existed or is no longer designed — `/ui2-component-delete <C-###> [reason]`. Strikes the row WITHOUT reusing its ID, removes its build artifacts, and reports every consumer it had. Refuses while any screen or component still renders it, because delete has no keeper to absorb anything. (Copied by the /components 2.0 UI's Prompt ▸ Delete dialog.)
argument_hint: <C-###> [reason] — e.g. C-054 "orphaned by the study-program-home re-spec"

name: ui2-component-merge
description: Merge a duplicate UI 2.0 registry row into the row that survives — `/ui2-component-merge <keep> <duplicate>`. Absorbs the duplicate's designed states into the keeper's contract, repoints every consumer, screen spec, element map and build artifact, then strikes the duplicate's row WITHOUT reusing its ID. Destructive by nature: it proves the two are duplicates before it moves anything, and never deletes history. (Copied by the /components 2.0 UI's Prompt ▸ Merge dialog.)

name: ui2-component-update
description: Verify ONE built UI 2.0 component preview against its spec AND its notes, fix what fails, recapture, and report. Derives the effective requirement set (contract + notes, newer wins per property), checks the built view and fixture against it, edits only MakeReadyUI/ and the fixture, and reports every place a note has overtaken the spec as drift for the owner to resolve. Never writes under docs/ui2. Designed to run in a FRESH session.
argument_hint: C-### registry id; omit to be shown the components that have notes

name: ui2-resolve
description: Resolve unresolved comments on a UI 2.0 component preview — one state (`C-034 default`) or every state (`C-034`). Figma is the reference; the SwiftUI preview view, its fixture, or — when the comment is an owner ruling — its contract is what changes. Edits, recaptures, verifies against the frozen snapshot, then replies + resolves. (Copied by the /components 2.0 UI's Prompt menu.)
argument_hint: <C-### [state-slug] — e.g. C-034 default, or C-034 for every state>

name: ui2-screen
description: Spec ONE UI 2.0 screen — ingest its Figma design (or doc source), decompose it against the program component registry, write the normative screen spec, and update the shared program artifacts (registry, tokens, screen map, README manifest). Spec-writing only, no app code. With no argument, takes the next item from docs/ui2/README.md's dependency-ordered spec queue. Designed to run in a FRESH session.
argument_hint: screen-id from docs/ui2/README.md — omit to take the next queued item; optionally followed by a Figma URL to attach/refresh the design source
